other_conditions: The worker must have completed ninety days of service as a registered worker in the current year.

The applicant must be registered with the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (or, if unregistered, provide a certificate from the builder or area inspector confirming they are a building worker).
The applicant must have been hospitalized for five or more days due to an accident or disease.
benefits_summary: Provides ₹400 per day for the first 5 days and ₹40 per day thereafter, up to a maximum of ₹2,000 per hospitalization.
documents_required: Prescribed format of the application form
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
